researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: Evidence is strong enough for research-ready S5 without a targeted follow-up batch. Official-source and field lanes needed one resend after empty completions, but final reports were usable. Remaining weaknesses are explicit import caveats: no confirmed official S5 campsite/water, urban service over-inclusion, side-facility policy, stale 18-20 km sources, route graph at Simlångsdalen branch hub, dynamic fire/transit/current works checks and exact road/rail/river crossing treatment for navigation-grade output.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Simlångsdalen - Halmstad, Södra delleden, S5 local/inventory label, official order 21, 28 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Simlångsdalen the route heads west along the old Bolmenbanan railway embankment, passing through the village, Marbäck and Skedala. At Brogård it joins the Fylleleden corridor and follows Fylleån toward Hagön and Östra Stranden before continuing through Halmstad's industrial and riverside approaches along Nissan to Halmstad Resecentrum.
